title: 3B1B × Epic History
_note: Extracted 2026-09-01 from the six Logic modules and content-manager/projects/logic.json. IMMUTABLE while a shipped master binds it — fork to epic-history-2 to change it.

writer.sentence: The history is the narrative spine; the mathematics is the discovery the viewer makes alongside the people in the story.
writer.register: Grave about the stakes, curious about the ideas. Short declaratives for the drama, longer looping sentences for the reasoning. Second person sparingly, never as chumminess.
writer.acts: Every section opens on a question or a want. People want things and fail. Let the viewer reach the idea a beat before the narrator names it. Name the stakes before the machinery. Taxonomy runs are forbidden. The concepts are a checklist, not an outline.
writer.cold_open: Wordless, under the bed, before any title. Living things move; no humans until the end; no exhibits. See COLD_OPEN.md.
writer.music_policy: one curated bed per module, classical or drone; never generated for a shipped module

checks._note: Read by the linter (v0.13.0). Numbers, not adjectives.

imagery.generated: backplates and texture only, never evidence

bindings._note: Only keys a shot list block may carry belong here: they land in beats/ fragments byte for byte. Prose about policy goes under `writer`.
